interface.title: EDF-Analyzer
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis of a single recording after it is acquired: quality control, measurement and reporting
interface.what_it_is_for: Upload a routine EDF recording with EEG and ECG channels, check how the channels were typed, review the traces, and compute EEG spectral and aperiodic measures plus ECG rhythm screening and HRV, with total and artifact-corrected results side by side, then export a report tagged with provenance.

data.note: I uploaded test_edf_datei.edf (10 min, 200 Hz, 19 EEG channels + ECG on POL X1) after signing in with the password and ticking the patient-data (GDPR) confirmation. Values checked against the manifest: posterior alpha peak 10.0 Hz (expected 10 Hz), O1/O2 alpha asymmetry +18% (expected +18%), mean HR 70.1 bpm (expected 70.1), 685 R-peaks (expected 685 of 702), and a no-beat gap flagged at 330–345 s (the planned dropout). The aperiodic exponent on O1 was 2.13 for 1–40 Hz and 2.17 for 1–20 Hz; the manifest expects 2.2. I switched the interface to English, but much of the result text is still in German. test_edf_afib.edf was not loaded.

features.name: Upload gate with patient-data consent
features.general: Before a recording is loaded, warn that it may carry identifying patient data and require an explicit authorization confirmation before loading it anyway
features.specific: File & Patient: Upload, GDPR/patient-data warning, 'I confirm that I am authorized…' tickbox, Load file anyway button
steps: upload the recording file
read the patient-data warning
tick the authorization confirmation
press Load file anyway
serves_tasks: Upload a recording, confirm permission for the identifying data, and enter subject details

features.name: Signal-based channel typing with confidence and manual override
features.general: Classify each data channel automatically, show the confidence and the reasoning for each one, let the user filter and sort the list, and offer a by-hand type correction
features.specific: Channel Identification: ECG/EEG summary tiles, type filter chips, sort by channel order/confidence/type, expandable channel card (rationale, Std / peak-to-peak / kurtosis / QRS rate / rhythmicity, band distribution, 10 s preview), Correct type dropdown plus Apply
steps: read the summary counts by type
filter by type and sort by confidence or type
expand a channel card to see its features, rationale and a signal preview
choose a corrected type and press Apply (Apply not pressed in this run)
serves_tasks: Check the automatic channel-type classification and the evidence behind it

features.name: Paged multichannel trace viewer with montage map
features.general: Browse a long multichannel time series one page at a time, with a selectable channel-pairing scheme shown on a head diagram, display filters, an amplitude scale, and a slider to jump to any page
features.specific: EEG Viewer: Montage dropdown (Doppelte Banane, Temporal, Parasagittal, Referenziell Cz) with an Active montage head map, epoch length, µV/trace ±, low/high cutoff filters, first/prev/next/last buttons and an epoch slider, plus an ECG lane fixed at the bottom
steps: pick a montage and watch the head map update
set the epoch length, scale and filters
step or drag the slider to an epoch
read the EEG traces against the ECG lane
serves_tasks: Look through the raw traces in a chosen montage and jump to a suspect time

features.name: Click-to-edit artifact mask with live total vs corrected comparison
features.general: Start from an automatic mask of bad time segments, add or remove segments by clicking on a trace canvas, and see summary metrics and all derived measurements recomputed side by side for the full data and the cleaned data
features.specific: Artifact Correction & Selection: detector settings, Overview (Sauberes EEG %, Verworfen s, Segmente, deltas vs Auto), Timeline of multichannel excursions, per-channel amplitude histogram, review canvas (click adds a 5-s artifact, click on a block removes it), then Gesamt/Korrigiert/Δ tables and bar charts for EEG band power and HRV, and an artifact-corrected export
steps: review the auto-detected segments on the timeline
click in the review canvas to add (or click a block to remove) a segment
check the Overview deltas against Auto
read the total vs corrected EEG and HRV tables
export the artifact-corrected report (not pressed in this run)
serves_tasks: Review the automatic artifact mask, add a manual bad segment, and compare total with cleaned results

features.name: Staged rhythm screening with traffic-light verdict and window navigator
features.general: Run a short ordered screening pipeline (signal quality → irregularity score → premature-event count), sum it up as graded flags rather than a diagnosis, and let the user page through one-minute windows with colour-coded detected events
features.specific: Rhythm Screening: ECG channel and R-peak detector selectors (validated detectors not installed), Schritt 1–3 cards, traffic-light overview (CosEn, SVES/VES events, P-wave coherence), dropout warning, polarity-check tachogram, 1-minute window navigator (Zurück/Weiter, HR/count/CV metrics, colour-coded R-peak markers, RR histogram)
steps: choose the ECG channel and detector
read the three step cards and the traffic-light verdict
open the polarity check to compare tachograms
page through 1-minute windows and inspect the colour-coded beats
serves_tasks: Screen the heart rhythm for irregularity and early beats, and read graded flags instead of a diagnosis

features.name: Interval-variability analysis with window choice and two-estimator spectra
features.general: Compute variability statistics of an event-interval series over the whole record or an automatically chosen stable sub-window, show the power spectrum from two estimators side by side with band shading and gap warnings, and place the result on a reference plot
features.specific: ECG & HRV: Analysis window (Whole recording / First 3 min / Most stable 3 min), time-domain cards (HR, SDNN, RMSSD, pNN50, Poincaré SD1/SD2, DFA α1, SampEn), Spectral method radio (Welch / Burg), Frequency domain tab with Welch and Burg PSDs and VLF/LF/HF bands, HRV findings tab with an ANS quadrant plot
steps: pick the analysis window
read the time-domain and nonlinear cards
open Frequency domain and compare the Welch and Burg spectra
choose which estimator feeds the findings
read the HRV findings quadrant plot
serves_tasks: Compute heart-rate variability over a chosen window and compare two spectral estimators

features.name: Manual challenge-phase marking on a rate trace
features.general: When a recording carries no annotations for a provocation or challenge period, show the rate trace so the user can set the phases by hand
features.specific: ECG & HRV › Hyperventilation tab: notice that no HVT annotations were found, + HV manual button, HR trace for manual phase setting
steps: open the challenge tab and read the no-annotations notice
press the manual-marking button
read the rate trace that appears for setting the phases
serves_tasks: Mark challenge phases by hand when the file has no annotations

features.name: Regional spectral panel with gradient and asymmetry indices
features.general: Compare spectra from two groups of sensors over a selectable time window and estimator, then sum them up as band shares, peak frequency, a front-back ratio and per-band left-right asymmetry indices with a threshold
features.specific: EEG Spectrum: Window start slider and Duration, Analysis options (Multitaper toggle, extreme-artifact filter), posterior/anterior spectrograms with the window highlighted, FFT comparison with the alpha peak marked, relative band power bars, A/P gradient cards, AI cards for O1 vs O2 and F3 vs F4 (|AI| > 20% flagged)
steps: set the window start and duration
optionally switch to multitaper or the artifact filter
read the spectrograms and the FFT peak
check the A/P gradient cards
check the per-band asymmetry indices
serves_tasks: Read band power, dominant rhythm, front-back gradient and left-right asymmetry, and repeat with another estimator and time window

features.name: Per-channel background-slope fit with cross-channel consistency
features.general: Fit the power-law background of a spectrum on a chosen channel over two frequency ranges, show the fit on log-log axes with its goodness of fit, and compare the slope across all channels against their median
features.specific: Aperiodic (1/f): channel selector, metrics (exponent 1–40 and 1–20 Hz, offset, R², corrected alpha peak), E/I index bar, log-log spectral decomposition with the aperiodic fit, exponent-per-channel bars against the median
steps: choose a channel
read the exponents for both ranges and the R²
check the log-log decomposition against the data
compare the per-channel exponent bars with the median
serves_tasks: Fit the background (1/f) slope of the spectrum and check it is consistent across channels

features.name: Own fit vs reference library under changeable model settings
features.general: Fit the spectral background with the tool's own method and with a reference library side by side, show both fits over the data with a parameter table, and let the user change the fit range and the model shape to see how the two diverge
features.specific: Advanced Analyses (W2): FOOOF vs eigen (sigma-clip) table and overlay plot, Fit-Obergrenze slider, Knee-Modell switch
steps: read the own-fit and reference-library exponents in the table
compare the two fits in the overlay plot
change the fit upper limit
switch on the knee model and compare the parameters and R² again
serves_tasks: Compare the tool's own fit against a reference implementation under different model settings

features.name: On-demand report export with provenance manifest
features.general: Generate report files only when asked, then download them as a document, a spreadsheet and a machine-readable manifest that records the software version, commit, package versions, parameters and a hash of the input data
features.specific: Report: collapsible tables (Recording & metadata, Cardiac analysis — HRV, EEG spectral analysis), Create reports, then Download PDF / Download Excel / Create visual report / Manifest (JSON)
steps: review the summary tables
press Create reports and wait for the computation
download the PDF and Excel files
download the JSON manifest and check the provenance fields
serves_tasks: Generate and download the report files with version, package and data-hash provenance
